newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yields fall further on Bulgaria discount T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall further on Bulgaria discount T-bills.

text.p: Yields fell further at Wednesday's auctions of Bulgaria's Finance Ministry one-week and four-week discount T-bills, central bank figures show.
The average yields to maturity on the two issues were 0.97 and 4.92 percent, respectively, down from 1.07 and 5.04 percent at Tuesday's auctions and 1.20 and 5.19 percent on Monday.
Bids were received for a total of 59.941 billion lev worth of T-bills as the one-week issue was oversubscribed and the four-week undersubscribed.
The ministry approved bids for a total of 51.821 billion levs of paper.
The issues were offered with par values of 12 billion levs and 45 billion levs, respectively and no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 12,000 million levs 45,000 million levs
Bids received 19,330.6 million levs 40,609.9 million levs
